name: Riving Pulse
description: Drive a riving pulse of sound into a single seam of a guard and split it wide.

name: Grave Drone
description: Lay a grave low drone on one foe that bows their body and slows their qi.

name: Resonant Balm
description: Pour a steady resonant balm of tone into an ally or the self until deep bruises and cracked ribs knit.

name: Cleaving Tone
description: Cleave through a guard with a hard tone drawn out to an edge.

name: Tectonic Hum
description: Hum in the very pitch of the ground until it heaves and breaks under every foe nearby.

name: Brittling Shriek
description: Shriek at the pitch that makes metal and bone brittle so that blades and guards snap at the next blow.

name: Bracing Reverb
description: Brace the body in a deep reverberation that breaks the force of great blows against its own ring.

name: Marrow Toll
description: Toll a note that passes through armor and flesh and rings in the marrow of the foe.

name: Shattering Wave
description: Send a wave of sound that shatters stone and steel and everything brittle in a wide ring about the user.

name: Absorbing Silence
description: Open a silence that drinks the sound and force of attacks aimed at the user and stores them for a time.

name: Frequency Seal
description: Seal a foe's qi to a single pitch that they cannot leave so that their techniques no longer ring true.

name: Ruin Frequency
description: Sound the frequency of ruin that the school keeps so that all that is brittle within the field fails at once.

name: Cataclysmic Dirge
description: Sing the dirge of the shattering wave so that it levels everything within the field to the full destructive ceiling of its tier and leaves the user spent.

name: Thrumming Lash
description: Lash out with a thrumming whip of sound that stings through a guard.

name: Weighted Tone
description: Sound a weighted tone so heavy that the foe cannot lift a limb against it.

name: Purging Resonance
description: Ring the resonance of the body clean so that poison curse taint and the backlash of a Qi Deviation shake out of an ally or the self.

name: Emptying Pulse
description: Send a hollow pulse that empties the foe's attention and spoils their stance.

name: Deafening Roar
description: Roar so loud that foes in the near field lose their hearing and their balance together.

name: Reflecting Hum
description: Hum a reflecting skin of tone that returns the sound and force of blows to those who threw them.

name: Heartstart Chord
description: Sound a deep chord that starts the stopped heart of an ally whose breath has just failed and holds the window open until life takes hold.

name: Bonebreak Peal
description: Peal a note at the natural pitch of bone so that it breaks from the inside.

name: Collapsing Resonance
description: Build a resonance in the field until its walls and floors and stone shake themselves to collapse.

name: Muted Heaven
description: Mute the air of the whole field so that foes within cannot call a technique or hear a command.

name: Perfect Pitch
description: Sound the one exact pitch of a single foe's being so that the harm passes through every ward and defense.

name: Last Resonance
description: Ring the last resonance of the school and let it run on after the foes have fallen until the field itself is cracked.

name: Collapse Requiem
description: Sing a requiem that brings a whole field down about those in it to the full destructive ceiling of its tier and drains the singer nearly dry.

name: Unsounded Requiem
description: Hold a requiem so low it cannot be heard that crushes everything in the field at the ceiling of its tier and leaves the survivors mute.
